capabilities: Render pinyin transliterations above Hanzi in reading and editing views
Colorize Hanzi and pinyin by tone with custom tone colors
Look up the current selection or line in a CEDICT-compatible dictionary
Copy Hanzi, pinyin, or translations from the lookup popup
Download and store a dictionary locally for offline use
extras: Installation is manual only (copy files into .obsidian/plugins on desktop or Android); the dictionary must be downloaded once from a configurable URL, after which the plugin works offline.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show pinyin annotations over Chinese characters or to look up Chinese words from within notes.

relations.evidence: Mandarin Helper uses pinyin-pro for Hanzi-to-Pinyin conversion and related pinyin normalization.

summary: Chinese-language helper that renders pinyin above Hanzi with tone coloring in reading and editing views and offers offline CEDICT dictionary lookup.
